meanings: to look out of the window

examples.en: The child is looking out of the window at the rain.

note: Uses «кроз» + acc. (literally "through"), not «у».

forms: literally: to be late five minutes

examples.en: The train is five minutes late.

note: No preposition: the length of the delay is in the accusative.

forms: literally: cancer-wound

examples.en: Corruption is a festering sore on society.

note: Figurative: a chronic problem, e.g. corruption. Written with a hyphen.

meanings: backing, support in reaching a goal
forms: literally: wind in the back

examples.en: Parents are a tailwind for their children.

meanings: you scratch my back and I'll scratch yours
forms: literally: one hand washes the other

examples.en: You know how it is: you scratch my back, I scratch yours.

note: Like the Latin «manus manum lavat».

forms: literally: a clean account, a long love

examples.sr: Враћам ти дуг, знаш: [чи̏ст ра̀чӯн, ду́га љу́бав].
examples.en: I'm paying you back, you know: short reckonings make long friends.

forms: literally: set them at odds, then rule

examples.en: Their tactic is divide and rule.

meanings: man is a wolf to man

examples.sr: Понекад се чини да је [чо̀век чо̀веку ву̑к].
examples.en: Sometimes it seems that man is a wolf to man.

meanings: do not cast pearls before swine
forms: literally: do not throw pearls before pigs

examples.sr: Не причај им, [не ба̏цај бѝсер пред сви̑ње].
examples.en: Don't tell them anything, don't cast pearls before swine.

key: phr:како будеш посејао, тако ћеш и пожњети

examples.sr: [Ка̀ко бу̏де̄ш посѐјао, та̀ко̄ ћеш и пожњѐти].
examples.en: You reap what you sow.

key: phr:ми о вуку, а вук на врата
forms: literally: we talk of the wolf, and the wolf is at the door

examples.sr: Баш смо о теби причали, [ми о ву̑ку, а ву̑к на вра́та].
examples.en: We were just talking about you, speak of the devil.

examples.sr: Пут је тежак, али [кроз тр̑ње до зве́зда].
examples.en: The road is hard, but through hardships to the stars.

meanings: everyone is the architect of their own fortune

examples.sr: Не чекај никога: [сва̏ко је ко̀ва̄ч сво̀је сре̏ће].
examples.en: Don't wait for anyone: everyone is the architect of their own fortune.

meanings: the voice of the people is the voice of God

examples.sr: Кажу да је [гла̑с на́рода бо̏жјӣ гла̑с].
examples.en: They say the voice of the people is the voice of God.

forms: literally: without a hair on the tongue

examples.sr: Он увек прича [без дла̏ке на јѐзику].
examples.en: He always speaks without mincing words.

forms: literally: a coin for haggling

examples.en: We will not be a bargaining chip.

note: A journalistic phrase: about someone used as an object of bargaining.

meanings: "Gone with the Wind" (title of the novel)
forms: literally: it rushed past with the whirlwind

examples.en: We watched the film «Gone with the Wind».

note: прохујати is to rush past, вихор is a whirlwind.

meanings: to be without a penny or a home
forms: literally: there is neither a puppy nor a kitten

examples.sr: Купио је кућу, а сада [не̑ма ни кучѐта ни мачѐта].
examples.en: He bought a house, and now he has nothing left.

note: куче is a puppy, маче a kitten; said of someone with no property and no family.

forms: literally: to jump out of the rails

examples.en: The freight train derailed.
Two cars derailed.

forms: literally: laundry machine

examples.en: The washing machine is broken.

note: Official: машина за прање веша; in everyday speech the short веш-машина.

meanings: something to eat with a spoon: soup, stew
forms: literally: something for the spoon

examples.sr: Сваки дан треба да поједеш [не̏што на ка̀шику].
examples.en: Every day you should eat something with a spoon, like soup.

note: Not only soup: goulash or beans too. It implies a warm, hearty meal.

forms: literally: to puncture the spoon

examples.sr: Угојила сам се, мораћу да [пробу̀шим ка̀шику].
examples.en: I've put on weight, I'll have to go on a diet.

note: Image: the food runs out of the leaky spoon and never reaches the mouth.

key: phr:кога је змија уједала, тај се гуштера плаши
forms: literally: whom a snake has bitten is afraid of a lizard

examples.sr: Једном су га преварили: [ко̀га је змѝја уједа̀ла, та̑ј се гу̏штера пла̏ши].
examples.en: He was cheated once: once bitten, twice shy.

forms: literally: a guiding star

examples.en: Knowledge was her guiding star.

forms: literally: to strike the tempo

examples.sr: Хајде да [у̏даримо тѐмпо] док нисмо уморни.
examples.en: Let's pick up the pace before we get tired.

meanings: to take an exit off the motorway
forms: literally: to switch oneself off the motorway

examples.sr: Код Београда смо се [искљу̀чили са а̀утопута].
examples.en: We took the exit near Belgrade.

note: An exit from a motorway is called «искључење».

forms: literally: chimney cake

examples.en: I bought a chimney cake with walnuts.

note: A sweet spiral pastry baked around a cylinder, like kürtőskalács.

forms: literally: blue hair

examples.sr: Ћерка има [пла̀ву ко̏су] и плаве очи.
examples.en: My daughter has blond hair and blue eyes.

note: «плав» means blue, but also a pale yellow shade: плава коса is blond hair, плавуша a blonde.

forms: literally: to sleep like a cannon

examples.en: After the mountains I sleep like a log.

forms: literally: light sleep

examples.sr: Он има [ла̏к са̏н] и стално се буди.
examples.en: He is a light sleeper and keeps waking up.

note: The opposite is тежак сан, deep sleep.

forms: literally: by a convergence of circumstances

examples.en: We met by coincidence.

note: Bookish but neutral; стицај is a convergence, a coincidence.

examples.en: She has feelings for him.
They are made for each other.

forms: literally: the kitty will come to the little door

examples.sr: Нећеш да ми помогнеш? [До́ћи ће ма́ца на вра̀танца].
examples.en: You won't help me? You'll come crawling back to me yet.

note: A variant: «доћи ће цица на колица». Cats come to be petted when they want something. A threat or gloating aimed at someone who refuses now.

forms: literally: the link that is missing

examples.sr: Нашли су [ка̀рику ко̀ја̄ недо̀стаје] у еволуцији.
examples.en: They found the missing link in evolution.

examples.sr: Живот у пустињи је [бо̀рба за о̀пстанак].
examples.en: Life in the desert is a struggle for survival.
The government introduced emergency measures.

meanings: how does it look on me? (clothes)
forms: literally: how does it stand on me

examples.en: How does this jacket look on me?

forms: literally: a lad as if broken off a hill

examples.sr: Његов син је [мо̀мак ка̏о од бре̑га одва̀љен].
examples.en: His son is a big strapping lad.

note: Said of a tall, broad, strong young man.

forms: literally: a cat's cough

examples.en: For him that's child's play.

note: Said of something easy, a small thing.

meanings: something for a cold (at a pharmacy)

examples.en: I'd like something for a cold.

examples.sr: Странка је [до̀шла на вла̑ст] после избора.
examples.en: The party came to power after the election.

examples.sr: Закон ће [сту́пити на сна̑гу] од јануара.
examples.en: The law will come into force in January.
The opposition did not recognize the results of the election.

forms: literally: to chase a connection

examples.sr: Прво треба [ју́рити ве́зӯ] да добијеш посао.
examples.en: First you have to pull strings to get a job.

forms: literally: to chase girls

examples.en: All he does is chase girls.

meanings: to try hard to get into a university

examples.en: She is trying hard to get into the university.
The city was hit by a natural disaster.
A wildfire threatened the village.

forms: literally: the internet is braking

examples.sr: Опет [и̏нтернет ко̑че], не могу да отворим страницу.
examples.en: The internet is slow again, I can't open the page.
Can you lower the price?
Can it be cheaper? I'm buying several pieces.

note: «Јел» is short for «је ли». A colloquial bargaining formula.

examples.en: I'd like to, but that is too expensive.

key: phr:од злог оца, а од горе мајке
meanings: bad through and through, from a bad family
forms: literally: from a bad father and an even worse mother

examples.sr: Он је [од зло̑г о̀ца, а од го̏ре ма̑јке].
examples.en: He is rotten to the core, just like his parents.

note: Said of things too, not only of people.

examples.sr: [Ка̀ка̄в о̀тац, та̀ка̄в си̑н], обојица воле пецање.
examples.en: Like father, like son: they both love fishing.

forms: literally: warm brother

examples.en: That is what they used to call a gay man.

note: Colloquial and derogatory.

forms: literally: it is even written on the fence

examples.sr: Знао сам да ће то бити објављено, [и на тара̀би пи̑ше̄].
examples.en: I knew it would be published, it's common knowledge.

note: тараба is a picket fence, and also the # key on a phone.

examples.en: The new president took the oath of office.
Relax, everything will be fine.

note: Often just «опуштено»: no big deal.

examples.en: Who runs this account?
You need to create a profile on the site.
I feel like a fish in water.
Come home, I'm hungry as a wolf.

forms: literally: smart as a bee

examples.en: She is clever as a bee.

meanings: whoever survives will tell the tale (of a situation with an unpredictable outcome)

examples.sr: Утакмица ће бити тешка, [ко̏ прѐживи при̑чаће].
examples.en: The match will be tough, whoever survives will tell the tale.

forms: literally: to go onto the nerves

examples.en: That noise gets on my nerves.
I just want to voice my opinion.

forms: literally: coffee to carry

examples.en: One coffee to go, please.

note: A calque of the English «coffee to go».

examples.en: The director bears responsibility for the mistake.

forms: literally: daytime stay

examples.en: The children are in the extended after-school program.
The furniture for the living room is new.
I've missed you too, kafana.

note: «И» here means "also". «Жељан сам» + gen.: to long for.

forms: literally: hot as a pepper

examples.sr: Кад је видео оцену, био је [љу̑т ка̏о па̀прика].
examples.en: When he saw the grade, he was furious.

note: «Љут» means both "hot, spicy" (of food) and "angry".

forms: literally: when the maple bears apples

examples.sr: Позајмицу ће вратити [ка̏д ја̏во̄р ја̏букама ро̏ди].
examples.en: He'll pay back the loan when pigs fly.

note: A maple tree does not bear apples, hence "never".

meanings: opening of a reply letter: I am writing about your advertisement

examples.sr: [Ја̏вљам се на Ва̏ш о̏гла̄с] за радно место књиговође.
examples.en: I am writing in response to your advertisement for the position of bookkeeper.

note: Business style. «Ваш» is capitalized in a letter.

examples.sr: [Пози́вајӯћи се на Ва̏ш до̏пис] од првог септембра, шаљемо вам понуду.
examples.en: With reference to your letter of September 1, we are sending you an offer.

note: «Допис» is an official letter from an organization. A typical opening of a reply in business correspondence.

examples.en: We inform you that the deadline has been extended.

note: Followed by «да» + verb. Formal, addressing «Вас».

examples.sr: Молимо вас да [и̏змирите ра̀чӯн] до петка.
examples.en: Please settle the bill by Friday.

note: In business language «измирити» means to discharge an obligation in full.

examples.en: You can make the payment by card.

note: Official wording; in speech people say «платити».

examples.en: We want to settle the debt in installments.

meanings: to be nowhere to be found
not to be had for love or money
forms: literally: there isn't even enough for medicine

examples.en: There wasn't a taxi to be found.

note: Said of something that is nowhere around, although it should be.

forms: literally: provoked by nothing

examples.sr: [Ни̏чим и̏зазван], почео је да виче на нас.
examples.en: Out of the blue, he started shouting at us.

meanings: something that does not really exist
forms: literally: a thought noun

examples.sr: Бесплатан паркинг у центру је [ми̏саона и̏меница].
examples.en: Free parking in the center is a pipe dream.

note: Humorous: about a thing that exists only in words and dreams.

examples.sr: На пословном путу смо [спо̏јили ле̑по и ко̏рисно].
examples.en: On the business trip we combined business with pleasure.

forms: literally: with forgiveness

examples.en: He is, pardon my language, a real fool.

note: An apology before a rude or indecent word.

examples.sr: [Не̏мој да ме гња̑вӣш] са тим питањима.
examples.en: Don't bug me with those questions.

note: Also «немој да ме смараш». Both are colloquial.

forms: literally: wipe off from here

examples.en: Get lost, I don't want to see you.

note: «Брисати» means "to wipe", but in the imperative it means "get out".

examples.en: Get out, right now!

note: «Мрш» is a categorical command, also used to shoo animals.

examples.sr: [У чѐму је фа̏зон]? Не разумем шалу.
examples.en: What's the deal? I don't get the joke.

note: Colloquial slang. Tone decides: it can be asked seriously or with irritation.

examples.en: Clubs are not my thing.

note: Colloquial slang. Also «нисам у фазону»: not in the mood.

examples.sr: Он је увек [у не̏ком сво̑м фа̏зону].
examples.en: He is always in his own world.

meanings: what is this supposed to be? (indignation)
forms: literally: what does this look like

examples.en: Look at the room, what is this supposed to be!

note: An indignant remark when something looks awful or unacceptable.

meanings: how can you not be ashamed?

examples.sr: [Ка̀ко те са̏мо нѝје срамо̀та] да лажеш!
examples.en: How can you not be ashamed to lie like that!

note: «Те» instead of «вас»: addressing one person informally.

forms: literally: is there an end to the outrage

examples.sr: [И̏ма ли кра̏ја безобра̀злуку]? Опет су повећали цене.
examples.en: When will this outrage end? They've raised prices again.

meanings: even my pigs live better (about awful conditions)

examples.sr: Погледај тај смештај, [мо̀је сви̑ње бо̏ље̄ жи̏ве].
examples.en: Look at that accommodation, even my pigs live better.

note: A sarcastic remark about poor conditions or a high price.

meanings: are you out of your mind?

examples.sr: [Да ли сте ви̑ но̏рма̄лнӣ]? Овде је забрањено пушити!
examples.en: Are you out of your mind? Smoking is forbidden here!

note: Sharp. Informal: «да ли си ти нормалан/нормална?».

examples.sr: [Сачу̀вај бо̏же] да ми се то поново деси!
examples.en: God forbid that this happens to me again!

forms: literally: a warm recommendation

examples.sr: Овај ресторан је [то̏пла̄ пре̏порука] за све путнике.
examples.en: I highly recommend this restaurant to all travelers.
The apartment has underfloor heating in the bathroom.

note: A literal «топли под» is not used.

forms: literally: there is no messing around

examples.en: No kidding, the deadline is tomorrow.

note: Colloquial, slang.

examples.en: Thanks for the information, we'll stay in touch.

note: A business closing. In writing, often just «на вези».

forms: literally: be well for me

examples.en: Okay, take care!

note: A friendly goodbye.

examples.sr: [По̀здрави сво̀је] и јави се кад стигнеш.
examples.en: Say hi to your folks and let me know when you arrive.

note: «Поздрави маму»: say hi to your mom.

examples.en: We'll see each other again, God willing.

note: A ritual addition to a farewell, more common among older people.

key: phr:драго ми је било да те упознам

examples.sr: [Дра̑го ми је би̏ло да вас у̀познам].
examples.en: It was nice to meet you.

note: Said at the end of a meeting. At the start: «драго ми је».

meanings: I'm not in the mood for

examples.en: I'm not in the mood for jokes today.

note: Followed by the genitive: «није ми до спавања» - I'm not up to sleeping.

forms: literally: by measure

examples.en: The suit was made to measure.

note: «Шивење по мери» is custom tailoring; «кројачка радња» is a tailor's shop.

meanings: that trick won't work on me
forms: literally: those tricks don't catch fire

examples.en: Those tricks don't work on me.

note: Colloquial. «Фора» here is a trick, a ploy.

examples.en: Get this: I won an award!

note: Colloquial slang. Said before a funny or surprising story.

forms: literally: you will not repent

examples.en: Call us, you won't regret it!

note: An advertising phrase: «покајати се» is to regret.

examples.sr: Не жели да [ди̏же фр̏ку] око тога.
examples.en: He doesn't want to make a fuss about it.

note: Colloquial. Also «правити фрку».

examples.en: I'm stressing out before the exam.

note: Negation: «није ми фрка» - I'm not worried, it's no trouble.

examples.en: He finally told her that he loved her.
In spring we do a deep cleaning of the apartment.
On Saturdays I go shopping at the market.

note: «Набавка» is buying groceries and necessities. Synonym: «ићи у куповину».

forms: literally: white equipment

examples.en: We sell large household appliances at good prices.

note: Refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, freezers.

examples.sr: Купили смо нову [маши́ну за пра́ње ве̑ша].
examples.en: We bought a new washing machine.

note: In speech often shorter: «веш машина». A dishwasher is «машина за прање посуђа» or «машина за судове».

examples.en: Astronomers observe celestial bodies.

forms: literally: the Moon's changes

examples.sr: [Мѐсечеве ме̏не] се понављају сваких двадесет девет дана.
examples.en: The phases of the Moon repeat every twenty-nine days.
Show me your ID card, please.

note: «Карта» is not only a ticket but also a card. It shows the ЈМБГ, a citizen's unique number.

forms: literally: wedding paper

examples.en: You need a marriage certificate for the visa.

forms: literally: health booklet

examples.en: Don't leave your health insurance card at home.
A certified copy of the diploma is required.

note: «Оверити» is to certify (at a notary, at the municipality).

examples.sr: Јуче ми се [по̀ломио зу̑б] на орасима.
examples.en: Yesterday I broke a tooth on walnuts.

note: «Поломио ми се» is reflexive: the tooth broke by itself. Broken: «зуб је поломљен».

examples.en: The car needs a minor service.

note: An oil and filter change and a fluid check; «велики сервис» is more extensive.

examples.en: I joined a hiking club.

note: Synonym: «клуб планинара». They organize «акције» - hiking trips.

examples.en: My head has been hurting for days.

note: The body part is the subject: «боли ме зуб». Plural: «боле ме леђа».

examples.sr: [Не о̀сећам се ба̏ш на̑јбоље], идем кући.
examples.en: I'm not feeling too well, I'm going home.

note: A polite way to say you feel unwell. Also: «не осећам се добро».

examples.en: - Is he conscious? - No, he isn't.

note: «Свестан је» - conscious, «није свестан» - unconscious.

key: phr:с једне стране... с друге стране
meanings: on the one hand... on the other hand

examples.sr: [С је̏дне стра́не] је скупо, [с друге стране] је сигурно.
examples.en: On the one hand it's expensive, on the other it's reliable.

examples.sr: [Пр̀во̄], проверите да ли је место безбедно. [Друго], позовите хитну помоћ.
examples.en: First, check that the place is safe. Second, call an ambulance.

note: Neuter ordinals used as linking words: прво, друго, треће, четврто.

examples.en: It's a pity I don't have enough time.

note: «Штета» also stands alone: «Штета!» - what a pity. After «што» comes an ordinary clause.

examples.sr: Ићи ћемо на излет, [без о̏бзира на то̑] што пада киша.
examples.en: We're going on the trip even though it's raining.

note: «Без обзира на» + acc.: «без обзира на околности». «На то што» introduces a clause.

key: phr:ругао се лонац лонцу, а оба су црна
meanings: the pot calling the kettle black
forms: literally: one pot mocked the other, and both are black

examples.sr: Он вас критикује? [Ру̏гао се ло̀нац ло̀нцу, а о̏ба су цр̏на].
examples.en: He criticizes you? The pot calling the kettle black.

note: A proverb about someone who reproaches others for what he does himself.

meanings: don't let anyone push you around

examples.sr: [Не да̑ј на се̏бе], брани своје мишљење.
examples.en: Don't let anyone push you around, defend your opinion.

note: Advice to someone who is being bullied. Also «не дај се».

examples.sr: Као деца смо [и̏шли по пѐчурке] у шуму.
examples.en: As kids we went into the woods to pick mushrooms.

note: To pick: «брати печурке»; a mushroom picker is «берач гљива».

meanings: do not cast pearls before swine

examples.sr: Не објашњавај му, [не ба̏цај би̏сере пред сви̑ње].
examples.en: Don't explain it to him, don't cast pearls before swine.
The decision has been made, the die is cast.
We need ground meat for the patties.

note: Mixed (beef and pork): «мешано млевено месо».

examples.sr: [Ра̏ди се о то̏ме] да немамо довољно новца.
examples.en: The thing is that we don't have enough money.

note: Impersonal: «ради се о» + loc. Answers the question "what is it about?".

examples.sr: [Извѝњавам се што̏ прѐкидам], али морам да кажем нешто.
examples.en: Sorry to interrupt, but I have to say something.
I'm not quite sure I'll make it.

note: «Баш» softens the negation: not very, not quite.

meanings: what do you do (for a living)?

examples.en: What do you do? - I work as a doctor.

note: «Бавити се» + instr.; "what" in the instrumental is «чиме».

meanings: I was born in (said by a man)

examples.sr: [Ро̏ђен сам у] Казању, а живим у Београду.
examples.en: I was born in Kazan, and I live in Belgrade.

note: A woman says «рођена сам». Date: «рођен сам дванаестог јуна».

examples.en: I speak English fluently and understand Serbian.

note: «Читам и разумем»: I read and understand.

examples.en: I'm not married, but I have a child.

note: Married: «ожењен» (man), «удата» (woman).

examples.sr: [Ни́сам слу̏жио во̑јску] јер је обавеза укинута.
examples.en: I haven't done military service because it was abolished.

note: A woman says «нисам служила».

examples.en: I'm in charge of contacts with partners.

note: «Задужен» - assigned the responsibility for it. A woman says «задужена сам за».

meanings: do you deliver to an address?

examples.sr: [Да ли доста̀вљате на адрѐсу]? Живим ван центра.
examples.en: Do you deliver to an address? I live outside the center.

meanings: I want to cancel my order

examples.sr: [Жѐлим да о̀ткажем нару̀џбину], стигла је погрешна роба.
examples.en: I want to cancel my order, the wrong goods arrived.
One item is missing from the package.

note: «Недостајати» takes the 3rd person: «недостаје један производ», «недостају два производа».

examples.en: Don't go off topic.

note: Short form of the command: «не скрећи са теме».

forms: literally: various stories circulate

examples.en: Various rumors about him are going around town.
He's looking for a serious relationship, not a fling.

forms: literally: public recorder

examples.en: We signed the contract at the notary's.

note: Written on signs; colloquially «нотар».

examples.en: Don't forget the vehicle registration in the car.

note: «Возачка дозвола» is a driver's license; «саобраћајна дозвола» is the vehicle's document.

meanings: to renew the registration (of a car)

examples.en: I want to renew my car registration.

note: «Регистрација истиче» - is expiring; «је истекла» - has expired; «важи до јуна» - valid until June.

examples.sr: [За̏што сте ме за̀уставили]? Нисам прекорачио брзину.
examples.en: Why did you stop me? I wasn't speeding.

forms: literally: monetary punishment

examples.en: That offense carries a fine.

meanings: to drive under the influence of alcohol

examples.en: It is forbidden to drive under the influence of alcohol.
He got a fine for illegal parking.
Stay a little longer, keep me company.

examples.sr: Хајде да [на̀правимо па̀узу] од десет минута.
examples.en: Let's take a ten-minute break.

note: Collocations with «правити»: «правити буку» (to make noise), «правити разлику» (to make a difference).

examples.en: Don't make a scene in front of everyone.
Drop it, nothing will come of it.

note: Imperative of «манути се» + gen.; plural «маните се».

meanings: to act like a big shot
forms: literally: to make oneself a cool guy

examples.en: He is showing off in front of the girls.

note: Slang. «Фрајер» generally means a guy, a bloke; with «правити се» it means a show-off.

forms: literally: to catch fire for someone

examples.en: Since when have you been into him?
Older ladies don't do it for me.

note: Slang. Takes «на» + acc.

meanings: to be slow on the uptake
forms: literally: to fire late

examples.en: You are always slow on the uptake.

note: The image is from an engine: «касно паљење» is late ignition.

forms: literally: it depends

examples.en: - What time do you usually have lunch? - It depends.
It all depends.

note: A short answer. In more detail: «зависи од саобраћаја» - it depends on traffic.

forms: literally: little bugs in the head

examples.en: He has hang-ups.

note: An old expression everyone understands. Slang replacement: «пун трипова». Not «бубашваба», a real cockroach.

forms: literally: hard on a para

examples.en: He is stingy.

note: Colloquial. «Пара» is a hundredth of a dinar, a tiny coin.

forms: literally: not to have even a broken para

examples.en: I don't have a penny until payday.

note: Strengthens the negation: «пребијена пара» is a para broken in half, so not even half a coin.

key: phr:не може и јаре и паре
meanings: you can't have your cake and eat it too
forms: literally: you can't have both the kid goat and the money

examples.sr: [Не мо̏же и ја̏ре и па̏ре], изабери једно.
examples.en: You can't have your cake and eat it too, pick one.

note: A proverb. «Јаре» (kid goat) and «паре» (money) rhyme.

meanings: at first glance it seems that...
forms: literally: at first glance it seems

examples.sr: [На пр̀ви по̏гле̄д се чи̏ни] да је лако.
examples.en: At first glance it seems easy.

note: A bookish phrase, typical of romance novels. Followed by «да» + clause.

forms: literally: the chances are small that

examples.sr: [Ма̀ле су ша̏нсе да] ће падати снег.
examples.en: It's unlikely that it will snow.

note: After «да» comes the future or a plain present verb: «да се то догоди».

forms: literally: I sympathize with you

examples.sr: [Саосѐћам с то̏бо̄м], знам како ти је.
examples.en: I sympathize with you, I know how you feel.

note: «Саосећати» takes «с» + instr.: «с тобом», «са њом».

forms: literally: spare me public shame

examples.en: Spare me the public humiliation, please.

note: Bookish: «поштедети некога чега» - to spare someone something (gen.).

forms: literally: known by

examples.en: Belgrade is known for the Victor monument.
Serbs are known for their hospitality.

note: «По» is followed by the locative: «по ракији», «по гостопримству».

forms: literally: work on the black

examples.en: He works off the books.

note: Also «црна берза» - black market, «црна листа» - blacklist.

key: phr:дај боже здравља, остало има код кинеза
meanings: health is what matters, the rest can be bought
forms: literally: God grant health, the rest is at the Chinese shop

examples.sr: [Да̑ј бо̏же здра̏вља, о̀стало и̏ма ко̏д Ки̏неза].
examples.en: Good health is the main thing, the rest we can buy.

note: A humorous saying: Serbia has many Chinese shops that sell everything.

meanings: if you've started, see it through
in for a penny, in for a pound
forms: literally: if you've pulled the trigger, shoot

examples.sr: Рекао си своје, па сад [а̏ко си по̀тегао, пу̏цај].
examples.en: You've said your piece, and since you've pulled the trigger, shoot.

note: A saying with a gun image.

key: phr:ако комшијска кућа гори, гледај у своју
meanings: someone else's trouble may reach you too, so stay alert
forms: literally: if the neighbor's house is burning, look at your own

examples.sr: [А̏ко ко̏мшијска ку̏ћа го̀рӣ, гле̏да̄ј у сво̀ју]!
examples.en: If your neighbor's house is burning, watch your own!

note: A warning proverb: don't gloat over another's trouble, it may touch you too.

forms: literally: your shop is open

examples.en: Your fly is open, zip up.

note: A jokey, tactful way to say it quietly.

forms: literally: only bone and skin remained

examples.sr: После болести је остао [ко̑ст и ко̏жа].
examples.en: After the illness he was left skin and bones.

meanings: to put on a lot of weight
forms: literally: to get fat like a she-bear

examples.en: She put on a lot of weight over the winter.

note: Colloquial, often mocking; «мечка» is a she-bear.

forms: literally: look after yourselves

examples.en: Goodbye, take care!

note: Became a common goodbye after the pandemic. Singular: «чувај се».

key: phr:изгубио се као магарац у магли
meanings: lost like a donkey in the fog
forms: literally: lost like a donkey in the fog

examples.sr: Нови у граду, [изгу̀био се ка̏о ма̀гарац у ма̀гли].
examples.en: He's new in town and completely lost.

note: A donkey is gray like fog, so it can't be found in it.

key: phr:не зна да ли је дошао или пошао
meanings: not to know whether one is coming or going
forms: literally: doesn't know whether he has arrived or set off

examples.sr: Од среће [не зна̑ да ли је до̏шао и̏ли по̀шао].
examples.en: He's so excited he doesn't know whether he's coming or going.

note: About someone who fusses and rushes about to no purpose.

key: phr:где људи пљују, ту река тече
forms: literally: where people spit, the river flows

examples.sr: Причало се по целом селу, [где̏ љу̑ди пљу̏ју, ту̑ ре́ка тѐче].
examples.en: The whole village was talking: word gets around.

meanings: now he's the one who comes asking
forms: literally: the kitty has come to the little door

examples.sr: Подсмевао се мени, али [до̀шла ма́ца на вра̀танца].
examples.en: He laughed at me, but now the tables have turned.

note: Said jokingly or as a threat: promising payback, or expecting the offender to come asking for help himself.

meanings: complain all you like, no one will listen
forms: literally: complain to the waterworks authority

examples.sr: Не свиђа ти се? [Жа̏ли се у̀прави водо̀вода]!
examples.en: You don't like it? Go complain to the water board!

note: A sarcastic reply to someone who complains in vain. The waterworks authority has nothing to do with it.

forms: literally: to walk rabid intestinal worms

examples.en: The child is running wild around the house.

note: Jokingly rude: about noisy, unruly behavior.

forms: literally: to come out at the end with someone

examples.sr: Не знам како [и̏злазиш на кра̑ј] са њим.
examples.en: I don't know how you cope with him.

note: «Изаћи на крај» alone means to see a job through; with «са» + instr. it means to manage a difficult person.

meanings: not to have the faintest idea
forms: literally: not to have even a faint connection

examples.sr: Он [не̑ма ни бла̀ге ве̏зе] о компјутерима.
examples.en: He hasn't the faintest idea about computers.

note: Said of someone who is completely clueless.

forms: literally: without connection

examples.en: All of this is nonsense.
It's kind of lame.

note: Colloquial. Not to be confused with «нема везе» - never mind.

forms: literally: drunk to the board

examples.en: Last night he was dead drunk.

note: Colloquial, often said after a feast.

meanings: to transfer money to an account
to pay money into an account
forms: literally: to pay into an account

examples.en: Yesterday I transferred the money to your account.

note: A banking phrase: «уплатити» is to pay money in.

forms: literally: intruder syndrome

examples.en: I have impostor syndrome at my new job.

note: Same meaning: «синдром варалице». Typical thoughts: «сумњам у себе» (I doubt myself), «не заслужујем свој успех» (I don't deserve my success).

forms: literally: to take to the heart

examples.en: Don't take everything to heart.

note: Usually used in a prohibition.

forms: literally: among the rest

examples.sr: Ту су, [и̏змеђу о̀сталог], и моје ствари.
examples.en: My things are here too, among other things.

note: An introductory phrase set off by commas.

forms: literally: except for this

examples.sr: Имам састанак у три. [О̏сӣм то́га], морам код лекара.
examples.en: I have a meeting at three. Besides that, I have to see the doctor.

note: An introductory phrase for adding a thought.
